title: Found a camp
description: Mark a camp on explored ground. Settlers gather and deliver 12 wood to build it.

title: Lay a road
description: Hold and draw a road from the camp: residents lay it by hand. Timber and stone yards are raised beside a road.

title: Build a workbench
description: An open bench where residents make tools, one at a time. It takes 4 wood.

title: Craft a wooden tool
description: A tool in the pack makes its work faster: an axe fells, a pick mines, a mallet builds, a hoe farms and a shovel tills and lays roads. Craft any one at the workbench.

title: Build a smithy
description: Gather 12 wood and 8 stone. The smithy makes weapons, shields and armor.

title: Make a weapon or a shield
description: Make a wooden sword or club at the smithy, or a shield to block blows.

title: Build a tent
description: Shelter the founders and make room for the newcomers to come.

title: Lay out a farm
description: Pick Farm and drag an area: the farmhouse is raised in its corner and the rest is tilled as its field. It takes 15 wood.

title: Build an altar
description: Odin's altar needs 4 stone: builders break grey rock by hand. No rock in sight? Explore for it.

title: Reach 4 residents
description: Set aside 4 food and a free bed, then create a resident at Odin's altar.

title: Upgrade the workbench
description: Pay 10 wood and 6 stone at the workbench: a resident works on it, and then it makes stone tools.

title: Build a lumberyard
description: Establish a timber supply near trees; its workers fell faster with axes in hand.

title: Build a well
description: Give your residents drinking water.

title: Build a quarry
description: Establish a supply of stone.

title: Upgrade the smithy
description: Needs a quarry and 4 residents. Pay 16 wood and 12 stone at the smithy: then it makes stone weapons, a reinforced shield and stone-studded armor.

title: Build a storehouse
description: Increase room for delivered resources.

title: Build a sawmill
description: Assign a worker to turn two logs into one plank for advanced construction.

title: Build stoneworks
description: Dress two rough stones into one cut stone for advanced construction.

title: Build a hostel
description: Earn lodging income from temporary visitors. Guests never become residents.

title: Build a tavern
description: Give residents somewhere to relax.

title: Reach 6 residents
description: Expand housing and supplies for growth.

title: Build a market
description: Needs a tavern and 6 residents. Let trade support the settlement.

title: Build a guild
description: Needs a quarry and 6 residents. The guild lets residents change callings from level 3.

title: Build a training yard
description: Build the yard to train Warriors at the guild and make spears at the smithy.

title: Swear a fighter
description: Choose a resident of level 3 or higher at the guild and train them in an open calling.

title: Beat off a raid
description: Raids are warned during the day. Gather your fighters by the camp and kill every raider that comes.

title: Build a watchtower
description: The tower shoots approaching raiders. It also opens Rangers at the guild and bows at the smithy.

title: Reach 10 residents
description: Support a larger working population.

title: Build a foundry
description: Smelt iron ore for the smithy. Take a stone pick into the snowy hills or bring ore home from a cleared floor.

title: Raise the smithy to iron
description: Needs a floor cleared beyond a gate and 8 residents. Pay 20 gold, 8 planks and 8 cut stone at the smithy: then it forges iron.

title: Forge an iron weapon
description: Smelt ore at the foundry. Bring the ingots and a stone weapon to a level 3 smithy to upgrade it.

title: Reach 12 residents
description: Expand the settlement.

title: Arm a fighter in iron
description: An iron shield, mail armor or an iron helmet keeps a fighter on their feet. Make one at the smithy.

title: Build an apothecary
description: Needs the altar of Odin and 8 residents. Its healer treats the hurt and closes lasting wounds sooner.

title: Build a chapel
description: Needs an altar and 10 residents. Gives residents a place to pray.

title: Reach 16 residents
description: Keep a growing town supplied.

title: Build a mage tower
description: Needs an apothecary. Develops a source of mana.

title: Lead a party of three
description: Find an open gate, choose three residents in the expedition window and set out.

title: Slay a floor guardian
description: Fight through to the heart of a floor and kill its guardian. When it winds up a slam, move your party off the marked ground.

title: Revive a downed ally
description: A resident at 0 health is downed, not dead. Select an ally and right-click the fallen one to revive them before they bleed out.

title: Raise a runestone
description: Opens once a guardian is slain or a resident has fallen. Carve the names of the fallen in stone: while it stands, the settlement grieves less.

title: Seal a gate
description: Kill the guardian of the third floor beyond one gate. A sealed gate never raids again and pays a great hoard.

title: Reach 30 residents
description: Maintain homes, food and water for everyone.

title: Build a portal
description: Needs a mage tower, a guild and a sealed gate. Draws more visitors, and for 8 mana pulls a party home from beyond a gate, even mid-fight.

title: Seal every gate
description: Close every gate to the other worlds to make Midgard safe.
